responsibility: Public declarations for RTL SSA instruction-change proposals. This header defines insn_change, which records a candidate deletion or replacement together with its new uses, new defs, move range, and cost, plus the insn_is_changing closure used to test whether an instruction is part of a batch of pending changes.
same_name_distinction: Declares the insn_change record and insn_is_changing_closure used to describe pending RTL SSA instruction edits; unlike changes.cc, it does not validate, recognize, cost, or apply those edits.
